name: Card Transaction 10
definition: Card transaction for which the authorisation has been requested.

Reconciliation.name: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.definition: Identification of the reconciliation period between the acquirer and the issuer or their respective agents.

InterBankSettlementDate.name: Inter Bank Settlement Date
InterBankSettlementDate.definition: Date when the settlement is expected.

InitiatorTransactionDateTime.name: Initiator Transaction Date Time
InitiatorTransactionDateTime.definition: Date and time of the transaction.

InitiatorTransactionIdentification.name: Initiator Transaction Identification
InitiatorTransactionIdentification.definition: Number generated by the transaction Initiator to assist in identifying a transaction uniquely. This value remains unchanged for all messages within a message pair exchange, for instance an initiation/response. It corresponds to the ISO 8583 field number 11.

TransactionLifeCycleIdentification.name: Transaction Life Cycle Identification
TransactionLifeCycleIdentification.definition: Unique identification to match transactions throughout their life cycle (for example, authorisation to financial presentment, financial presentment to chargeback). It shall contain the same value in all messages throughout a transaction’s life cycle. It corresponds partially to ISO 8583: 2003 field number 21.

AmountNetReconciliation.name: Amount Net Reconciliation
AmountNetReconciliation.definition: Net value of all gross amounts.
